raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: yen
  version: 0.6.1

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/yen-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9ecff428998b6ba7ca2ae4d8ef3350ac8d2031b60a66c38d7863bbad4ba9ef37

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - yen=yen.cli:cli

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - microvenv >=2023.2.0
    - rich >=13.5.3

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - yen
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - pip check
      - yen --help

about:
  summary: Yet another Python environment manager.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/tusharsadhwani/yen

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pavelzw
